learning_retention.answer: Keep original receipts and frozen outcomes; retain post-quality export and analyst reconciliations separately. Product current knowledge needs an explicit final-status account, not a replay of all run history.
proposals: Separate historical snapshots from current-status statements using existing knowledge homes.

further_learning.answer: A new reader must distinguish completed from deferred intent; no next-reader run occurred. Review cost and material corrections are both measured, but causal value is unknown.
proposals: Prospectively test completed, deferred and historical statements; measure reader decisions before claiming a gain.
